text: Comms panel just before firing: no visible countdown or indication how long the rescue window remains; only redshift/brightness/appears-at slowly changing and 'Falling. It looks almost normal from here.' Hard to judge 'wait as long as you dare'.

After the beam reached her, Ines's 'Engine's lit! I'm climbing. I'm coming home!' (tick 3951) is followed by 'The black fills most of the window now.' (tick 4071) - reads as if she is still falling after climbing; and 'Engine's lit' is missing from the INES, AS RECEIVED log on the comms panel (log shows black fills / overhead bright / [You fired]).

After 'Engine burn seen at 4.56 rs. She is climbing out' the comms readout freezes (ship clock stuck at 98.5 M / 58.2 s for 200+ ticks) while its status line still says 'Falling. It looks almost normal from here.' - contradicts the header. WREN later says her picture 'will keep falling for a while', but the picture is frozen, not falling.

After the comms panel said 'Engine burn seen at 4.56 rs. She is climbing out', the in-world comms monitor keeps showing her falling deeper: 'seen at 2.49 rs, 1+z 2.46' (earlier 3.51 rs / 1.83) - mismatches the panel (frozen at 4.56 rs / 1.572). No objective shown after the rescue for 300+ ticks: unclear what to do next.
After Ines docked, the in-world comms monitor reads 'Recall beam: armed' again; and no new objective appears for ~600 ticks after docking - player is left idle with no direction.

The 20 s hold is implemented as a new numbered objective every second: events log objective_completed/objective_started for 'Hold at twice the relay rate: 20 s to go', '19 s to go', ... (objective numbers 3,4,5...). Visible HUD is fine, but progress/telemetry counts are inflated.

After 'Held for 20 seconds' (tick 9518) no objective or cue to go back up for ~700 ticks; I clicked 'Return to 10 rs' at tick ~10200 and Ines's 'Okay. That's enough. Take us back up.' only arrived at tick ~10400 when the ship was already at 9.3 rs.
Objective 'Return to 10 rs (helm)' stays incomplete for 150+ ticks after the ship reaches 10.000 rs and WREN says 'Back at station' (still incomplete at tick ~10840).
